dct_description_sm: THIS IS A GEOREFERENCED FILE. The South-Eastern Districts of Vancouver Island, from a Trigonometrical Survey made by the Honble. Hudsons Bay Company, by J. D. Pemberton, Engr. and Survr. to the Company. Published 2nd October, 1855. By John Arrowsmith, London. 1 mile to 1 inch. [Vancouver Island, 1855]. Show First nations locations. Inset map shows Strait of Jaun de Fuca and Gulf of Georgia.
